note: Browserbase MCP is the only workable source channel (all local egress receives WAF 403 from the Azure Application Gateway); asset bytes are also fetched through the browser session. acquire-source is unusable for this site. Three frames per P0/P1 checkpoint before any comparison; Kameleoon A/B testing is active so frames must be captured within one session and variance recorded. Hard stop before any payment field. Trajectory recorder attaches to the browserbase CDP session for the funnel walk (structure/sequence only; never during credential entry).
